stories.title: Yellow fog warning for Flintshire from 6pm tonight until Tuesday morning
stories.summary: A yellow weather warning for fog is in place across Flintshire from 6pm today until 10am on Tuesday. The Met Office says fog will redevelop this evening, becoming dense at times overnight, with visibility reduced to less than 100 metres. It says this will likely lead to some delays to transport and difficult travelling conditions.

stories.title: Connah’s Quay power plant steps up as wind output drops and grid operator asks for more generation
stories.summary: Connah’s Quay power station is running three of its four gas turbines at close to full output this morning, while Britain’s electricity system operator asks for extra generation to cover a dip in its spare capacity. stories.title: Deeside Taekwondo Academy raises £510 for breast cancer charity
stories.summary: A wear it pink evening at Deeside Taekwondo Academy has raised £510 for the breast cancer awareness charity CoppaFeel! The charity was chosen by Deeside Taekwondo student Ellen Williams, and teaches young people to get to know their bodies, spot changes and know when to seek medical advice.
